headline.title: Indian tech tycoon bets $30M of his own money to build AI alternative to Microsoft Office
headline.summary: Indian tech entrepreneur Bhavin Turakhia has invested $30 million of his own funds to develop Neo, an AI-driven alternative to Microsoft Office and Google Apps. This marks Turakhia's fifth venture in the enterprise software sector.

articles.title: Meta Is Charging a Subscription for Smart Glasses Features. Welcome to the New Era of Consumer Tech
articles.summary: Meta is introducing a subscription model for its smart glasses, requiring users to pay for "expanded access" to advanced features after purchasing the hardware. This move marks a shift in consumer tech, where additional functionality is now tied to ongoing subscription fees.

articles.title: The latest AI news we announced in June 2026
articles.summary: In June 2026, significant advancements in AI technology were announced, highlighting new features and updates in various applications. The updates focus on enhancing user experience and integrating AI capabilities across different platforms.

articles.title: New York City educators and industry leaders gathered at Google’s offices to shape the future of AI in classrooms.
articles.summary: Educators and industry leaders convened at Google's offices in New York City for an AI summit organized by Google, the New York Jobs CEO Council, and Urban Assembly. The event aimed to discuss and shape the future of AI integration in classrooms.

articles.title: RareDxR1: Autonomous Medical Reasoning for Rare Disease Diagnosis Beyond Human Annotation
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced RareDxR1, an autonomous AI system designed to enhance the diagnosis of rare diseases by performing medical reasoning without relying on human annotation. This approach aims to address limitations in existing AI methods that often lose critical information during phenotype extraction and retrieval processes.

articles.title: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity
articles.summary: The Seed2.0 model series aims to address complex real-world tasks by focusing on users' genuine needs and developing a robust evaluation system based on realistic benchmarks. It specifically targets challenges related to long-tail knowledge and complex instructions to enhance AI performance in practical applications.

articles.title: PHREEQC-MCQ-200: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Tool-Augmented Scientific Simulator Agents
articles.summary: The article introduces PHREEQC-MCQ-200, a benchmark designed to assess tool-augmented scientific simulator agents in the context of deterministic aqueous-geochemistry simulations. It consists of 200 multiple-choice questions based on 21 validated PHREEQC scenarios, aimed at evaluating the reliability of these agents when accessing scientific software.

articles.title: UltraFlux: Data-Model Co-Design for High-quality Native 4K Text-to-Image Generation across Diverse Aspect Ratios
articles.summary: The article introduces UltraFlux, a new approach to text-to-image generation that addresses the challenges of producing high-quality native 4K images across various aspect ratios. By employing a data-model co-design strategy, UltraFlux overcomes limitations in positional encoding, VAE compression, and optimization that hinder existing diffusion transformers.

articles.title: Prompting GPT-5 on Scrum Certification Questions: An Empirical Accuracy Study
articles.summary: This study investigates the accuracy of GPT-5 in answering Scrum certification questions, focusing on the impact of various prompting techniques. The findings highlight the model's ability to reason about Scrum, a framework governed by specific rules outlined in the Scrum Guide (2020).

articles.title: EO-VGGT: Orbital Ray-Conditioned 3D Foundation Models for Satellite Multi-View Reconstruction
articles.summary: The article discusses the development of EO-VGGT, a new 3D foundation model designed to enhance satellite multi-view reconstruction by addressing the challenges posed by the differences between traditional perspective assumptions and orbital pushbroom geometry. This advancement aims to improve the quality of Digital Surface Models (DSM) generated from multi-view optical satellite imagery.

articles.title: VideoSearch-R1: Iterative Video Retrieval and Reasoning via Soft Query Refinement
articles.summary: The article introduces VideoSearch-R1, a novel approach for video retrieval and reasoning that utilizes soft query refinement to enhance both inter-video and intra-video reasoning tasks. This method addresses the limitations of existing retrieval systems by integrating retrieval and reasoning processes, enabling more effective handling of complex video corpora.

articles.title: Cross4D-JEPA: Dense Cross-modal Correspondence Distillation for 4D Point Cloud Representation Learning
articles.summary: The article introduces Cross4D-JEPA, a method for dense cross-modal correspondence distillation aimed at improving 4D point cloud representation learning. It addresses the challenges of annotating dynamic 4D point clouds by leveraging self-supervised pretraining to create transferable representations, moving beyond traditional intra-modal approaches.
